tailored:
Dear iwoca hiring team,

What draws me to this role is the shape of the work: building the internal systems a growing operation depends on, and owning projects from problem to delivery. I have spent the last year building exactly that kind of full-stack system, and before that twenty years in a regulated, security-critical environment where reliability and structured work mattered daily.

Two pieces of my experience fit directly. First, TalentHiv: I designed and built a complete system end to end — React/TypeScript frontend, FastAPI backend with a layered REST API, PostgreSQL with SQLAlchemy and Alembic migrations, validation, error handling, Pytest testing, and deployment to Azure App Service with Key Vault. Second, at Casino Cosmopol I led operational teams of 50+ people, owned incident handling and escalation processes, and built the documentation and routines that kept complex workflows running — experience I would use to understand what operations staff actually need from their tools.

I use AI daily in my development flow, including LangChain and Azure OpenAI integrations in production-like projects, and I build with Python and TypeScript as my main stack.

I am based in Malmö, Sweden, and hold EU citizenship.

Best regards,
Anthony Foran
